scope: Independent acceptance contract and black-box pure/mock source only; FM owns production files.
commit_order: Actual ordinary cold proposal and actual worker callback occur through unchanged HPO machinery.
Every actual fit node supplies its ordered prepared input, stopping-validation, effective fit settings and actual native/runtime identity through the supported source hooks.
The callback returns a statusOK inner observation with a finite native non-bool numeric objective.
Source-bound actual parent completion, original-clock/resource observations and full cleanup are confirmed; missing or unknown evidence is not replaced by a caller boolean.
All expected fit nodes and private job/result/split/source references are complete and consistent for this exact current epoch.
Only then may one bounded exclusive bank entry be committed/sealed. Any failure before final publication leaves no admissible bank observation.

identity_acceptance.closed_typed_encoding: Versioned closed schema and length-delimited native typed values; no object repr/str fallback, bool-as-number, rounded floats, unordered set coercion or 64-bit row-hash authority.
preworker_context: Complete current source/producer/archive epoch and source closure
Original input byte references plus declared task/spec roles, ordered features/classes/output columns and metric implementation/direction
Ordered outer fitting, HPO fitting/validation and all actual worker stopping/calibration partitions
Complete raw/normalized/effective recipe settings, feature code/view, transform, sampling, augmentation, weighting, stopping and calibration semantics
Explicit fit_iterations absence or exact supplied value, seeds, thread/native environment settings, Python executable/ABI and actual native binary/package source fingerprints
Original parent/worker cap and normal-completion contract without any renewed allowance
every_actual_fit_node: Deterministic recursive component/inner/calibration/outer scope and actual execution order
Prepared fitting X value digest plus ordered index/schema/dimensions/native dtypes/category order/missingness
Actual transformed y, weights and augmentation parent-row identities supplied at this node
Actual stopping validation X/y/metric inputs separately scoped; no fitting-only feedback claim for these validation inputs
Actual effective constructor/fit settings and actual post-fit/native witness, not requested params or version labels alone
identity_acceptance.first_supported_scope: Only the source-authorized existing plain LightGBM leaf and its existing fixed two-view expansion; unsupported engines/wrappers or an unobserved recursive fit node remain bank-unqualified.
identity_acceptance.path_and_process_provenance: Actual job/result/split/parent artifacts and execution identities are diagnostic/source authority. They must not be confused with deterministic value identities or native compatibility.
identity_acceptance.future_lookup_boundary: Stored prepared digests are producer evidence only. No future consumer may validate a new input by comparing the entry to itself; no consumer is implemented here.

reject_without_commit: Wrong/missing epoch, source closure, typed schema, native binary/effective setting or any ordered value/partition identity
Missing, duplicate, reordered or unsupported fit-node scope; missing or malformed private artifact reference
Non-OK, timeout, exception, partial, nonfinite or bool objective; source/parent/cleanup/resource/observation uncertainty
Deadline expiry or bounded bank entry/file/encoding limit reached before final publication
Duplicate trial authority, pre-existing output, symlink/unsafe path, malformed/cyclic/unserializable payload
negative_acceptance.original_HPO_observation_semantics: Rejecting a bank witness does not fabricate or relabel the original HPO callback/value. Existing valid/failed/duplicate/unattempted study accounting and source-defined technical-stop handling remain unchanged.
negative_acceptance.failure_preservation: Keep the original primary failure; record secondary serialization/seal failures separately. A late publication failure cannot leave an admissible positive entry.

separate_counts: actual worker callback invocations and fresh valid/failed returned observations
bank admitted/rejected observations and actual bank compute/IO cost
accounting.anchor: Fresh anchor is still executed first, may be recorded, and is explicitly ineligible for any future reuse.
accounting.actual_model_process_launches: NULL unless separately observed by an existing actual parent receipt
accounting.recursive_learner_fits: NULL unless complete actual fit instrumentation proves them; callback count is not a learner-fit count

prepared_black_box_test_boundaries: No commit before actual parent/source/cleanup completion; one complete current-epoch trial commits exactly once.
Independent prepared/native/effective/source/partition/metric/seed/thread mutation cases change identity or reject; version-only native proof is rejected.
All-node completeness/order and unsupported engine/wrapper cases cannot silently qualify.
Timeout/error/bool/nonfinite/partial/unclean/deadline cases remain bank NULL and noncommitted without rewriting original callback accounting.
Exclusive publication, caller-payload mutation after seal and primary-versus-secondary failure edges retain immutable truthful evidence.
DefaultOFF invokes no identity/bank IO; reviewed whole-module inverse restores the exact current base, including existing context/selector code.
Fresh anchor, duplicate/noncallback proposals and process/fit NULL counts remain explicit; no lookup/hit/warm-start/saving claim.
integration_boundary: Candidate code/module-map/registry/canonical/source-gate execution are FM/root-owned. Existing legacy HPO/LOSS whole-AST methods/assertions/witnesses must survive an exact reviewed producer-OFF inverse; no hidden exclusions.
